hero.tagline: Built backends before AI made it easy. Now I use both.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I've been writing .NET backends since 2022 — before LLMs became the default pair programmer. ASP.NET Core, C#, GCP, Kubernetes: learned by doing, not by prompting. That hands-on foundation is what I consider my real edge.
Not just backend. I've built frontends in React, and in Blazor when staying inside the .NET ecosystem made sense. Enough to close the loop myself — not enough to call myself a frontend specialist.

Now I work at the intersection of .NET and LLMs — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini. Real engineering background means I know which problems AI actually solves and which ones it just confidently gets wrong.
